verdict.why: Local containers now automatically get Docker privileges for FUSE under certain Docker setups.

draft.detail: Miniflare now automatically passes Docker privileges for FUSE to local Durable Object containers on rootless Linux Docker with /dev/fuse, macOS, or WSL

source.quote: Miniflare now automatically passes the Docker privileges needed for FUSE to local Durable Object containers when using local rootless Docker on Linux with `/dev/fuse` available, or a local Docker engine on macOS or through WSL where Linux containers run in a VM.
